learning_objective: 🎯 Add big feelings and strong emotions to your sentences using exciting exclamation words!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An interjection is a short, sudden word that expresses a very strong feeling! It can show happiness, sadness, surprise, or even pain. Example: 'Wow! That is a huge cake.'
Interjections are so full of energy that they usually stand alone and are always followed by an Exclamation Mark (!). This mark tells the reader to say the word with excitement!
We use different words for different feelings! 'Hurrah!' for joy and winning. 'Alas!' for sadness. 'Ouch!' for sudden pain. 'Yuck!' for something disgusting.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 The Emotion Actor
fun_activity.instructions: Stand in front of a mirror and practice your best acting skills! Say 'Ouch!' while holding your toe, 'Yum!' while rubbing your tummy, and 'Wow!' with wide open eyes!

quick_recap: ⭐ Interjections express sudden and strong emotions or feelings.
⭐ They are almost always followed by an exclamation mark (!).
⭐ They help make our writing and speaking sound much more lively and expressive!
